name: Do I need a permit for exterior lighting installation in South San Francisco?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for exterior lighting installation in South San Francisco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permit requirements for exterior lighting installation can vary by city and the scope of the project. In South San Francisco, minor installations may not require a permit, but projects involving significant electrical work, new circuits, or changes to the main electrical panel typically do. It's essential to comply with local building codes and regulations to ensure safety and avoid potential issues. As part of our service, City Dweller, LLC will determine if a permit is needed for your specific project and manage the permitting process on your behalf.
